eventtitle: Countering Deepfakes with ST Engineering’s AI Forensics Platform
description: Misinformation and deepfakes are rising globally, posing risks to national security, public trust, and organisational credibility. Built entirely on AWS, ST Engineering’s AGIL Trust is a cloud-native SaaS platform that helps organisations detect, analyse, and respond to digital threats at scale. Using Amazon Bedrock for secure foundation models and Amazon SageMaker for MLOps, model training, and orchestration across 40+ AWS services, AGIL Trust integrates AI-powered fact-checking, deepfake detection, and influence campaign analysis to deliver scalable, real-time protection and preserve organisational trust and resilience.
